Question: In November 2026, the UN Security Council extended the asset freeze and travel ban under its Yemen sanctions regime until which date?
Explanation: The resolution, adopted by consensus, extended the asset freeze and travel ban until Nov 14, 2027; the Panel of Experts mandate runs to Dec 15, 2027. (Dawn)

Question: The UN arms embargo on Yemen's Houthis, which has no expiry date, was imposed under which Security Council resolution of April 2015?
Explanation: Resolution 2216 of April 2015 imposed the arms embargo; the Council reaffirmed it in November 2026. (Dawn)

Question: Who was Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the UN who condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia at the Security Council in November 2026?
Explanation: Ambassador Syed Haider Shah demanded an immediate and unconditional end to Houthi attacks and called for a Yemeni-led political process. (Dawn)

Question: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait, threatened by the Houthi escalation in 2026, links which two bodies of water?
Option A: Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman
Option C: Arabian Sea and Gulf of Aden
Option D: Red Sea and Gulf of Aden
Explanation: The Bab el-Mandeb is a key shipping route linking the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden. (Dawn)

Question: Which country hosted the COP31 climate talks held in November 2026?
Explanation: COP31 was held in Turkiye, which pushed a global electrification proposal; Brazil hosted the previous year's COP. (The Express Tribune)

Question: Under the split presidency arrangement at COP31 in 2026, which country served as lead negotiator?
Explanation: Australia led the negotiations while Turkiye hosted the summit, and Australia was drafting a political text to be agreed by consensus. (The Express Tribune)

Question: According to an OECD report released in November 2026, how many new permanent immigrants did OECD countries record in 2025?
Explanation: OECD countries recorded 6.1 million new permanent immigrants in 2025, down 1.6pc from 6.2 million the year before. (Dawn/AFP)

Question: Which OECD country saw the largest rise in permanent migrants in 2025, an increase of 139pc?
Explanation: Portugal's permanent migrants rose 139pc to 313,600, mainly due to approval of a backlog of residency permits. (Dawn/AFP)

Question: According to the OECD, which country was the leading country of origin for migration to OECD countries in 2024?
Explanation: India was the top source of migratory flows to the OECD in 2024, ahead of China and Colombia. (Dawn/AFP)

Question: How many member countries does the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) have?
Explanation: The OECD has 38 member countries; its 2026 migration report covered flows to all of them. (Dawn/AFP)

Question: After ICC judges closed parts of the Afghanistan investigation in 2026, arrest warrants remained in effect against how many Afghan Taliban leaders?
Explanation: Judges closed the inquiry lines covering US troops and ISIS-K, but warrants against four Taliban leaders remain in effect; the prosecutor appealed. (Dawn/Reuters)

Question: When did the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria place Pakistan under its Additional Safeguard Policy?
Explanation: The Global Fund invoked the ASP on Pakistan in August 2020, citing weak performance in HIV and TB programmes. (Dawn)

Question: The Global Fund's Additional Safeguard Policy has been revoked in only three countries. Which of these is one of them?
Explanation: The ASP, adopted in 2004, has been invoked in about 30 countries but revoked only in Cuba, Myanmar and Côte d'Ivoire. (Dawn)

Question: According to WHO and UNAIDS estimates, roughly how many new HIV infections did Pakistan record in 2024?
Explanation: New HIV infections in Pakistan rose from about 16,000 in 2010 to 48,000 in 2024, a 200pc increase. (Dawn)

Question: According to the 2023 census, what was Pakistan's annual population growth rate?
Explanation: The 2023 census put the population at 241.5 million, growing at 2.55% a year; the National Population Council has called this a national emergency. (The Express Tribune)

Question: What weightage does the current National Finance Commission formula give to population in distributing resources among provinces?
Explanation: The NFC formula assigns 82% weightage to population, which critics say should be reconsidered. (The Express Tribune)

Question: The Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC) was set up in 2023 through an amendment to which law?
Explanation: The SIFC was created in 2023 by amending the BOI Ordinance, 2001; Section 10E lets it direct federal bodies. (Dawn)

Question: Under Pakistan's Auto Policy 2026-31, the proposed Automotive Development Levy is expected to raise how much over five years?
Explanation: The levy is expected to raise Rs232bn over five years; the policy also targets about $6bn in auto exports. (Dawn)

Question: How many agreements, joint ventures and MoUs were finalised at the close of the Pakistan Mineral Investment Forum 2026 in Islamabad?
Explanation: Pakistan announced 13 mineral cooperation deals, aiming to move away from exporting raw minerals. (The Express Tribune)

Question: What share of the Reko Diq project is owned by Barrick Gold?
Explanation: Barrick Gold owns 50% of Reko Diq; its chairman John Thornton said in November 2026 it would remain a long-term partner. (The Express Tribune)

Question: According to the Institute of Cost and Management Accountants (ICMA), Pakistan's mineral reserves are estimated to be worth about how much?
Explanation: ICMA estimates Pakistan's mineral reserves at about $8 trillion, spread over 600,000 square kilometres. (The Express Tribune)

Question: In 2026, National Resources Limited partnered with which university to develop a predictive AI model for mineral exploration in Balochistan?
Explanation: NRL, a venture of Fatima Fertilisers, Liberty Mills and Lucky Cement, teamed up with LUMS on an AI exploration model. (Dawn)

Question: In November 2026, Turkiye's MTA International Company and the Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation signed a joint venture to explore antimony, copper and gold in which district of Balochistan?
Explanation: The MTAIC-PMDC venture covers antimony, copper, gold, silver, molybdenum and other critical minerals in Pishin. (The Express Tribune)

Question: At COP31 in 2026, PM Shehbaz Sharif said Pakistan had added nearly how much rooftop solar capacity in two years?
Explanation: The prime minister cited nearly 22GW of rooftop solar added in two years, largely by households facing costly electricity. (Dawn)

Question: What share of new vehicle sales does Pakistan aim to have as electric vehicles by 2030?
Explanation: Pakistan targets 30pc of new vehicle sales to be electric by 2030 and backs raising electricity's share of energy use to 35pc by 2035. (Dawn)

Question: In mid-November 2026, after its ninth consecutive cut, what was the retail price of petrol in Pakistan per litre?
Explanation: Petrol was cut by Rs2 to Rs330 per litre, while high-speed diesel stayed at Rs360. (Dawn)

Question: According to the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, short-term inflation (SPI) for the week ending Nov 12, 2026 stood at what rate year-on-year?
Explanation: The weekly SPI rose to 11.21pc year-on-year, driven mainly by perishable food items. (Dawn)
